title: Worker Handoff
description: Defines the structure for a Builder agent's formal handoff of completed work to the Integration Lead. Every handoff MUST include SHA256 for all files, a complete contract checklist, and a transcript reference.

handoffId.description: Globally unique handoff identifier. Format: handoff-{agentId}-{timestamp}.

agentId.description: Identifier of the agent performing the handoff.

capsuleId.description: The capsule this handoff is associated with.

files.description: Complete manifest of all delivered files. Every file MUST have a SHA256 checksum and size.

sha256.description: SHA256 hex digest of the file contents at handoff time.

contractChecklist.description: Every item in the capsule contract checked off with evidence.

item.description: Description of the contract item being checked.

completed.description: Whether this contract item is satisfied.

evidence.description: Concrete evidence proving completion (e.g., file path, log excerpt, checksum).

transcriptRef.description: Path to the agent's activity transcript proving real work was done.

knownIssues.description: Issues the agent is aware of at handoff time. Empty array means no known issues.

description.description: Clear description of the known issue.

workaround.description: Available workaround, if any. Use 'NONE' if no workaround exists.

nativeGenerated.description: MUST be true. Indicates this handoff manifest was generated by the agent system.

verifiedBy.description: agentId of the verifier who confirmed this handoff. Initially null, set by Integrator after validation.
